RIDDHI RAVINDRA BAHIRA Mumbai | riddhibahira1@gmail.com | +91- 9372489636 | Linkedin | GitHub

Data Science Graduate Skilled in Python, SQL, Power BI, with hands-on experience in Middle office Trade support across Equities, Fixed income, OTC trades, Derivatives, and securities lending and borrowing.Proven ability to reconcile trade data, investigate breaks, prepare management reports, and collaborate with trading desks and counterparties.

SKILLS • Programming language - HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Java, J2EE,JDBC,Jsp,Servlet • Products - Fixed Income , Equities, Derivatives, Securities Lending & Borrowing • Middle Office-Trade Lifecycle (Capture, Validation, Confirmation, Settlement), Trade Reconciliation, Break Resolution • Tools - Mainframe, Equilend, Pirum, IMBAL Tool, Solar, Macros

WORK EXPERIENCE Eclerx Services Ltd | Finance Analyst

Jan 25 – Jul 26

Managed end-to-end lifecycle of securities lending trades, including booking, amendments, daily mark-to-market, and collateral reconciliation for cash and non-cash positions, ensuring high accuracy and control.

Processed and validated high volumes of trades within strict deadlines,consistently meeting SLAs and minimizing settlement delays. Collaborated with Front Office and counterparties to investigate and resolve pricing and trade discrepancies, reducing trade breaks and improving settlement efficiency.

Performed daily operational controls, including record date checks and imbalance checks, to ensure end-of-day position accuracy. Assisted in preparing and maintaining weekly MIS reports, including Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), to track trade volumes and amendment trends.

Performed collateral- related reconciliation and MTM exposure monitoring, identifying discrepancies and supporting break resolution to ensure accurate margin and risk reporting.

Conducted detailed contract comparisons and reconciliations, reviewing rates, quantities, prices, and dividend details to ensure alignment with counterparty confirmations.

Handled adhoc operational tasks and supported procedural updates to ensure alignment with regulatory changes and process improvements. Provided oversight on trade amendments and lifecycle events, maintaining strong risk controls across the team. Utilized Mainframe systems for amendments and leveraged Equilend and Pirum platforms.

Develop interactive Power BI dashboards to provide real-time visibility into stock borrow/lend activity, collateral exposure, and settlement KPIs.

Drove a 30% reduction in reconciliation discrepancies through process improvements and Excel Macro-based workflow automation, saving 2+ analyst hours per week.

Teleperformance | Operations & Support

June 22 - Jan 23

Provided exceptional customer service with a focus on satisfaction.Efficiently handled customer inquiries and resolved issues promptly.

Proactively identified and resolved customer problems through troubleshooting.

PROJECTS E-Authentication System using QR code and OTP Description: Developed an E-authentication system using Java. Technologies:HTML,CSS,Java,MySQL It is a Student Attendance System which involves high security transactions that are made even highly protected using QR OTP.
